display_name: Select the cheapest clearing cell or strongest eligible cell with shortfall
description: Select the cheapest enabled accepted scored/priced cell clearing required_score + score_margin within runtime when supplied. If none clears, return the strongest eligible enabled cell, selected by highest measured capability_score with runtime/model/effort lexical tie-break independent of cost. selection_mode is strongest_available, shortfall holds required_score, effective_required_score, capability_score and positive gap; warnings loudly disclose the shortfall and any strongest-score tie. Preserve the original difficulty score. Operator-disabled, unknown-effort, unaccepted, unpriced and per-call constrained cells cannot enter the fallback. An enabled accepted scored pin with nonempty pin_basis retains its existing override semantics. Allowance telemetry does not affect eligibility or ranking. Stale readings remain usable and are reported even for the selected fallback; a stale selection requests refresh when no recent refresh exists. It takes no kind of work. Its enablement is the stored cell flag, which only rules without a kind set, at the last policy write, so a rule scoped to a kind never reaches it and a global rule end time reaches it at the next policy write. select_model_cell_for_kind applies a kind's rules and then calls this selection with the caller's required_score and narrowing.
embedding_description: Choose the cheapest capable AI model and reasoning effort, or the strongest eligible enabled cell when available capability falls short, with explicit measured shortfall, deterministic tie disclosure and stale-data notices.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Selected tuple, selection_mode, billing_objective resolved from the solet's usage plan, required/effective score, optional shortfall {required_score, effective_required_score, capability_score, gap}, frontier, dominated cells, effort ladder, clearance/exclusion counts, stale advisories/readings and catalog run. strongest_score_tie counts equal strongest cells. warnings disclose capability shortfall, ties, stale catalog, truncated census or missing weights. below_threshold counts failed clearance even when fallback cells are used. No quota telemetry participates.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Name the selected model, effort and measured score. Surface CAPABILITY SHORTFALL and STRONGEST SCORE TIE warnings prominently, including effective threshold, selected score and gap. Explain selection_mode strongest_available means no eligible cell cleared the unchanged ask. Stale-reading warnings remain advisory.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use selected.runtime, selected.model and selected.effort to dispatch, retaining required_score as the original difficulty score. Carry shortfall and warnings onto the Unit when the caller supports it; the dispatching engine's dispatch-lane and delivered-to-review discard these successful-reply fields, so Unit persistence is follow-on work. The advisory is loud in the verb reply now. A stale selection is valid: dispatch with it and report the age. Refresh is already requested when the notice says so; report refresh failures without blocking dispatch.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One catalog read plus in-memory selection. No selection writes or network; stale selection returns a follow-on refresh request.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_empty: no enabled scored cells. catalog_unaccepted: no enabled known-effort cell accepted. catalog_unknown_effort: enabled scored cells have no known effort. catalog_ineligible: no accepted priced cell remains under per-call constraints; exact exclusion counts name why. A threshold shortfall returns a successful selection, not no_cell_clears_threshold. pin_cell_unavailable: requested tuple is absent, disabled, unaccepted or unscored. parameter_invalid: malformed request. usage_economics_invalid: economics weights are malformed/unreadable/ambiguous. State integrity errors propagate. Allowance telemetry cannot refuse selection.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect catalog, read_model_cell_policy and exact exclusion counts for a genuinely empty eligible set. Correct or clear mistaken per-call constraints and select again. Preserve the assessed difficulty: an above-ceiling ask returns the strongest eligible cell and explicit shortfall. Operator enablement remains deliberate; a pin does not bypass it. Stale data is advisory.
